title: Unify dynamic clarification forms across Agent workflows

Introduce a shared typed clarification contract and modal, continue Ask AI/Plan/Recovery with submitted answers, and retain user answer summaries in the relevant conversation or intervention history. AI Create already has typed clarification rounds and should align with the shared interaction behavior.
acceptance_criteria: AgentAction questions support text/number/select/boolean metadata; Ask AI automatically opens a clarification modal and persists submitted answer summaries in the resource chat transcript before continuing; Plan AI Fill opens the same modal and displays submitted answer records; Recovery can persist pending questions, accept typed answers, show clarification history, and continue proposal generation; AI Create retains its modal dynamic form and transcript; remote Draft creation/rerun remains behind plan review/approval; backend/frontend tests and production build pass.
close_reason: Closed

acceptance_criteria: Successful AI Create response contains a remote draft_id; the Draft appears selected on Project entry with canonical parameters; the bound local plan remains preflight-valid and requires no parameter edits; approved run uses the existing Draft ID; retries do not create duplicate Drafts; invalid preflight continues through Agent Recovery; tests and build pass.

Live historical Plan verification returned completed with logs and persisted Case ID; all Go tests, 266 web tests, and production build pass.

title: Stop requesting unsupported legacy mesher node count
description: Preflight currently classifies Flow360's 'target_surface_node_count is not supported by the legacy mesher' validation error as a missing engineering input. Any entered value remains invalid. Convert incompatible-field errors into an automatic schema-safe repair or an explicit mesher choice, and never present an unusable value form.
acceptance_criteria: With legacy mesher selected, target_surface_node_count is removed rather than requested; applying the recovery reruns preflight and clears this error; a supporting mesher path is only offered as an explicit engineering choice; issue classification and UI copy do not call incompatible fields required values; Go/React regression tests and production build pass.
notes: Root cause: the preflight bridge projected every located validation error into a required value field, including discriminator/context incompatibilities. Added a field_removal recovery type that emits JSON merge-patch null, validates that users cannot substitute another value, and renders a high-confidence schema-safe repair card. Legacy mesher editor schemas now omit target_surface_node_count unless use_inhouse_mesher or use_geometry_AI is active. Plan UI distinguishes repairs from engineering inputs and handles mixed recovery forms. Installed Flow360 25.10 smoke reproduces the original error and proves the removal revalidates successfully. Full Go packages passed (server rerun with localhost permission), Flow360/plans race and vet passed, 256 React tests passed, SSR confirms no numeric input, and production/embedded builds passed.
close_reason: Unsupported legacy-mesher fields now produce an actionable removal repair and disappear from incompatible editor schemas.

Fix deterministic CAD execution paths and add bounded stage-aware recovery so CAD generation, project import readiness, and parameter preflight failures retry or invoke Agent repair without exposing internal diagnostics to users.
acceptance_criteria: CAD runtime uses canonical absolute paths and reproducer succeeds from relative work directories; retryable infrastructure failures retry locally; CAD semantic failures feed diagnostics back to the Agent for a corrected blueprint; Flow360 asynchronous readiness remains bounded and resumable; user sees recovery progress or actionable engineering questions rather than stack/path errors; tests and build pass.
close_reason: Fixed duplicated relative CAD runtime paths, classified stage failures, added bounded local retry and Agent geometry repair, continued created Projects into parameter recovery, and passed real CadQuery plus full regression tests.

title: Use canonical Flow360 unit tokens in schema forms
description: Dimension-aware selectors currently expose display-style unit names such as meter and meter/second, but Flow360 SimulationParams serializes canonical unit tokens such as m. Derive selectable values from the Flow360/flow360-schema unit registry or validated model serialization, keep friendly labels separate from submitted values, and never render recognized unit fields as free text.
acceptance_criteria: Length and all other recognized quantity selectors submit exact tokens accepted by the installed Flow360 version; labels may be human-friendly but wire values are canonical; invalid/free-text unit entry is impossible; existing values normalize safely; real Flow360 model validation plus Go/React tests and production build pass.
notes: Inspected /Users/juzhongsun/Projects/Flow360 and installed flow360-schema 25.10.17. The active {value,units} serializer emits str(unyt_value.units.expr), producing m, m/s, m**2, Pa, K, etc.; PhysicalDimensionMeta.si_unit long names are dimension identifiers, not canonical wire tokens. Editor schemas now canonicalize every compatible unit with the same unyt expression rule, expose controlled selectors only, and carry narrow aliases for legacy long-name values. Server validation requires units, accepts only declared options/aliases, and expansion writes canonical tokens. UI normalizes declared legacy values, blocks unknown stored units, and never provides free-text unit entry. Verified installed-schema smoke, all Go tests, race, vet, 243 React tests, TypeScript/Vite build, and make build.
close_reason: Dynamic forms now submit only canonical Flow360 unit tokens and reject uncontrolled unit strings.

title: Replace AI Create STL pseudo-geometry with CAD-safe asset workflow
description: AI Create currently generates cylinder.stl and uploads it as Flow360 geometry. STL is a tessellated surface representation, while this repository and Flow360 Geometry workflow accept CAD/B-rep inputs such as STEP, IGES, BREP, CAX, and CATIA. Real mesh logs show 'Not supported geometry type: cylinder.stl'. Correct the asset semantics and strengthen the AI Create instructions/capability gate.
design: Do not convert tessellated STL into a STEP wrapper and call it CAD. Geometry generation must preserve analytic surfaces/topology through a CAD kernel and undergo local parse/shape validation. A tessellated asset may only enter as surface-mesh when it satisfies that workflow's requirements. Missing CAD-generation capability is a request-missing-input state, not permission to fabricate geometry.
acceptance_criteria: AI Create never uploads STL/OBJ as source_type geometry; generated primitive geometry is emitted as an analytically exact CAD/B-rep file produced and validated by an approved CAD kernel, or the Agent requests a supported CAD upload when that capability is unavailable; blueprint records representation, format, generator, validation and provenance; prompt distinguishes CAD geometry, surface mesh and volume mesh and does not claim unsupported generation; backend rejects incompatible extension/source combinations before Flow360 submission; tests reproduce cylinder.stl rejection and cover the corrected route; full tests/build pass.
notes: Confirmed root cause from real Flow360 logs: cylinder.stl was accepted into a Project but rejected downstream as 'Not supported geometry type'. Replaced the STL triangulation generator with an embedded analytic OpenCascade BREP generated by CadQuery 2.6.1 / OCCT 7.8.1. Independently read back and validated: valid shape, exactly 1 solid, 3 analytic faces, volume pi/4, Triangulations 0. Blueprint now records representation/format/generator/version/validation provenance and template version v2. Explicit non-template diameter/radius/span values are rejected with a STEP/IGES/BREP request. AI system prompt now distinguishes CAD/B-rep Geometry from STL/OBJ tessellations and forbids renamed/wrapped mesh pseudo-CAD. Backend checks allowed Geometry extensions and BREP content before Flow360 submission; tests reject STL and renamed STL. Verified go test ./..., 242 Vitest tests, TypeScript/Vite build, make build, git diff check, and reproducible CadQuery validation script.
close_reason: AI Create now uses a CAD-kernel-generated validated analytic BREP instead of STL pseudo-geometry, enforces representation/source compatibility, and explicitly requests supported CAD outside the audited template.

title: Render Flow360 units as dimension-aware selectors
description: Schema-driven Plan forms currently render units as free text and can default a velocity quantity to meter. Derive allowed units from Flow360 quantity schemas and render controlled selectors so users cannot enter invalid or dimensionally incorrect units.
acceptance_criteria: Quantity units render as selectors; length and velocity expose dimensionally correct options and defaults; free-text units are eliminated from Plan schema forms; sparse serialization remains valid; tests, production build, real Flow360 schema smoke, and browser verification pass.
notes: Flow360 25.10 quantity wire schemas expose {value,units} but omit the physical dimension from JSON schema. The preflight bridge now recovers each field's SI dimension generically from Flow360 Pydantic annotations, propagates it through nullable/union schemas, and generates compatible unit_options. No parameter names are hard-coded. Real browser verified length selector meter/mm/cm/km/inch/ft, velocity selector meter/second/cm/second/ft/second/km/hr/mph/knot, no free-text .units controls, and no overflow. Installed Flow360 schema smoke, Go test/race/vet, 242 Vitest tests, and production build pass.
close_reason: All recognized Flow360 physical quantities now render dimension-aware unit selectors with server-side option validation.

title: Recover AI Create root Geometry ID after project creation
description: AI Create successfully creates a Flow360 Project, but the current CLI create response can contain only the Project ID. normalizeImportResult then fails with 'Flow360 import did not return the root resource ID', leaving a real Project without its local Case plan. Actual affected project prj-88c02308-0a06-4838-a030-a2cbdab8958d exposes root Geometry geo-5ad5216a-4716-4813-b92d-1dee0467a1ca through project items.
acceptance_criteria: AI Create requests synchronous root processing; if create output still omits root ID, backend queries project items and resolves the matching root resource; bounded retries handle eventual consistency; successful recovery creates the local Case plan and navigates to the Project; failure response includes the Project ID for recovery; tests cover project-only create output, delayed item visibility, and normal inline root IDs; full tests/build pass.
notes: Confirmed the reported Project was successfully created asynchronously: prj-88c02308-0a06-4838-a030-a2cbdab8958d, with root Geometry geo-5ad5216a-4716-4813-b92d-1dee0467a1ca returned by flow360 project items. AI Create now calls project create with --sync, then falls back to bounded project-items polling when create returns only project_id. Recovery preserves the original Flow360 result, resolves the typed root, and continues Case-plan creation. Exhausted recovery errors explicitly say the Project was created and include project_id. Added end-to-end project-only response coverage plus delayed visibility and failure tests. Verified go test ./..., 242 Vitest tests, git diff check, and make build.
close_reason: AI Create now treats root creation as asynchronous, waits with --sync, and recovers the Geometry ID through bounded project-items polling; full tests and build pass.

title: Replace Plan JSON patches with stage-aware schema forms and AI fill
description: Plan creation currently requires users to author JSON merge patches. Implement schema-driven forms scoped to the actual source-to-target route (Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh/Case combinations), add AI-assisted form filling using resource, baseline, Flow360 schema and CFD context, keep raw JSON as expert-only fallback, and preserve preflight/review/approval safety.
design: Use the installed Flow360 SimulationParams JSON schema as authority. Add a route-aware schema projection API and a controlled reusable form editor. Canonical UI state is structured values; patch JSON is compiled output. Agent receives the same projected schema plus baseline/resource context and returns a reviewable proposal. Source/target route follows Geometry -> SurfaceMesh -> VolumeMesh -> Case, including same-stage Case variation.
acceptance_criteria: Every valid source-to-target route renders only its downstream stages; stage parameter editing uses dynamic schema forms rather than JSON textareas; AI can propose structured form values with assumptions/evidence/provenance and never bypasses validation; compiled patches pass existing server validation and Flow360 preflight; expert raw patch remains available; React/Go tests and production build pass.
notes: Implemented installed-Flow360-schema projections for every valid source-to-target route; sparse dynamic stage forms; AI fill endpoint constrained by active schemas, compilation and Flow360 preflight; expert raw JSON fallback; UI/API/backend tests. Verified Go test/race/vet, 138 Vitest tests, production build, real Flow360 25.10.3 schema smoke, desktop and 390px browser layouts. Browser AI smoke correctly requested missing reference area; a later local Codex provider retry returned 502 timeout after 2m2s, with no validation bypass.
close_reason: Stage-aware schema forms and AI-assisted filling implemented and verified across valid Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh/Case routes.

Downloads manifest plus exactly one manifest-selected default LOD buffer per SolidGeometry; validates type/id, JSON, canonical .bin paths, default LOD, 64-file cap, 25 MiB per-file/total cap, regular files and 180 s timeout. Added typed VisualizationError kinds and a parsed catalog of render objects, Face/GeometryGroup groups, sections, non-structural fields and bounds. Preserved GeometryVisualization alias for compatibility. Live read-only tests passed on SurfaceMesh sm-41c6a47e (about 10 s), VolumeMesh vm-911c1d77 (about 67 s, 16 objects), and Case case-88018358 (about 34 s). go test ./... and diff check pass.

title: 让 Agent 推荐并预填边界条件恢复方案
description: 问题：当前 entity_assignment 虽使用模型下拉框和 surface 复选框，但仍要求 CFD 用户理解 Assign boundary conditions、自己判断 Wall/Freestream 等含义并手工选择。对 Vibe Simulate 来说，Agent 应先基于现有模型意图、Geometry 实体、Schema 错误和上下文生成推荐，用户只需接受或纠正。当前 ddd 计划已有 Wall(*) 与 Freestream(farfield)，因此可高置信度推断 6 个物理 face 应继承现有 Wall；该推断应以证据和 provenance 呈现，而不是隐藏为默认值。
design: 在 preflight recovery schema 中增加 recommendation contract：recommended_model、recommended_entities、confidence、reason、evidence、provenance。推荐器只从可审计证据推导，优先继承现有有效模型意图，不凭空决定物理类型；高置信度建议自动预填但不自动提交。SchemaForm 将 Assign boundary conditions 改为面向任务的 AI recommendation 卡片，默认展示推荐结果、影响范围和 Change 按钮；高级模型下拉与 surface 选择折叠为可修改选项。提交仍生成新 revision 并自动 preflight。
acceptance_criteria: 当前 ddd 计划打开恢复表单时默认选择现有 Wall 和六个未分配 face；界面用自然语言解释推荐原因、置信度和证据，不要求用户先理解 Assign boundary conditions；用户可一键 Apply AI recommendation，也可展开修改模型或 surface；无文本字段；推荐不会自动提交；服务端校验推荐 choice/entity IDs；React、Go、真实 Flow360 fixture 与浏览器验收通过。
notes: 已实现：preflight bridge 从原始 SimulationParams 中识别现有 wildcard boundary intent，为 entity_assignment 输出 recommended_model、recommended_entities、confidence、reason、evidence 和 provenance；当前 ddd 计划高置信度推荐复用 Wall 并预选六个 face。前端默认展示 Vibe Simulate Recovery / Agent recovery path 卡片、推荐原因、证据、模型与影响面摘要，主按钮为一键 Apply AI recommendation & validate；高级模型下拉与 surface 复选框折叠到 Change recommendation，无文本输入且不自动提交。真实 Flow360 fixture 证明推荐 patch 后 valid=true；ego-browser 证明默认 6 selected、编辑时 Wall + 六项全选；Go test/race/vet、40 Vitest、production build 和 diff check 通过。
close_reason: Agent 已能根据现有模型意图自动推荐并预填边界恢复方案，用户默认只需审查和一键应用。

title: 实现 Agent 主导的 Vibe Simulate 异常恢复闭环
description: 背景：VibeSim 的目标不是让用户手工逐项修复 CFD 表单，而是由 agent 观察仿真过程、理解异常、提出修复方案，并根据用户意见自动调整 SimulationParams。当前 preflight 虽能生成动态表单，但异常恢复仍由用户自行解释和操作，缺少 agent orchestration。范围：为 preflight/schema error、mesh failure、solver failure、convergence anomaly 和 remote execution error 建立统一 Intervention 状态；agent 获取 Project 本地镜像、资源链、当前 plan/revision、semantic diff、Flow360 schema issues 和日志证据；输出原因、置信度、影响、需确认事项和一个或多个 patch proposal；接收用户自然语言反馈后修改 proposal、自动本地验证并持续迭代；仅在最终 schema/工程 gate 通过后进入审批。
design: 建立 Observation -> Diagnosis -> Proposal -> User feedback -> Patch compile -> Local validation -> Re-observe 的有状态 agent loop。每次 intervention 绑定 project/resource/plan revision，产物持久化且可审计。Agent 可以自动执行只读查询、本地 patch 草案、schema preflight 和非付费检查；不得自动批准或启动付费 Flow360 资源。动态 SchemaForm 退居为 request_missing_input action 的结构化补充：agent 应先解释为何需要该信息、推荐值及其工程依据。参数建议必须区分 schema-required、从现有项目继承、agent 推断和用户确认四种 provenance。
acceptance_criteria: 任意 plan preflight error 自动创建可见的 agent intervention，而不是只显示红色错误；agent 能针对缺失边界条件解释原因并生成 Wall/其他边界分配建议；用户用自然语言修改建议后，agent 生成新 revision、显示 semantic diff 并自动 preflight；新错误会继续进入同一闭环直到 valid；mesh/solver/convergence/remote errors 复用统一状态机；所有建议带证据、置信度和 provenance；远程付费执行仍要求显式审批与最终确认；包含持久化恢复、重启续接、Go/React 测试和真实 Flow360 端到端验收。
notes: 2026-07-29 remediation: compiled Agent patch is now applied to the bound plan as a new revision before real Flow360 preflight; invalid retries re-enter the same auditable intervention instead of creating duplicates. Feedback is persisted separately and cannot leak private _feedback fields into SimulationParams. Preflight proposals use signed schema recommendations and never reinterpret issue paths as Geometry IDs. Added plan-specific recovery endpoint so Let Agent resolve creates/returns the exact plan revision, then automatically diagnoses and generates proposals. Empty intervention collections now serialize as [] and the modal no longer crashes. Real production/default browser evidence on ddd plan plan-7bda38521d077a96: one click opened a visible Agent Recovery modal and progressed Diagnosing -> Awaiting selection with 3 proposals; desktop and 390x844 had zero horizontal overflow. Go/race/vet/golangci-lint, 45 Vitest, production build pass. Remaining before closure: user/CFD owner must select or correct the proposed boundary intent for a real apply-and-revalidate loop; convergence/remote terminal trigger evidence should be recorded.
close_reason: Closed

title: 修复删除已不存在 Project 时的失败提示
description: Workspace 缓存列表可能包含已删除 Project；Flow360 delete 返回 404 Item not found 时当前接口报 502，导致 UI 显示删除失败且项目留在列表。
acceptance_criteria: Project delete 对 Flow360 404/Item not found 幂等成功；UI 移除陈旧项目并刷新列表；其他错误记录真实原因并返回可操作提示；有回归测试。
notes: Confirmed screenshot Project prj-ecdc...129d9 returns Flow360 404 Item not found. Made project deletion idempotent for remote not-found responses, added already_absent success payload, actionable permission/auth errors, server logging, and regression tests.
close_reason: Closed

title: Make Ask AI clarification forms explicit and recommendation-first
description: Ask AI currently auto-opens a clarification modal before the drawer is opened, and legacy questions without explicit types render as textarea-only forms. Require an explicit session action, infer safe controls for legacy questions, and have the Agent provide reasoned defaults so users can usually confirm and continue.
acceptance_criteria: Project entry never auto-opens Ask AI clarification; pending request appears as a button in the Ask AI session; opening is user initiated; text questions use single-line inputs while numeric/select/boolean questions use appropriate controls; Agent prompt requests safe reasoned defaults; recommended defaults are visibly prefilled and can be confirmed in one click; old sessions receive safe control/default fallbacks; tests and production build pass.
close_reason: Ask AI now exposes pending clarification as an explicit session button and never auto-opens it; shared forms infer friendly controls for legacy questions, prefill safe recommendations, show their rationale, and offer one-click confirmation when complete. Affected Go/UI tests and production build pass.

title: 增加 Project 重命名和删除管理能力
description: Workspace Project 列表和卡片缺少 rename/delete 操作入口。
acceptance_criteria: 列表行末和卡片均可打开管理菜单；支持重命名并刷新列表；删除需明确不可恢复确认；后端仅调用 typed Flow360 project rename/delete；有测试且错误可见。
notes: Implemented typed project rename/delete CLI calls and guarded server endpoints. Added list/card action menus, rename/delete dialogs, explicit deletion confirmation, live list refresh, tests, and browser verification without live mutations.
close_reason: Closed

title: 显示 My workspace 根目录并优化 Parent folder 选择器
description: Workspace 文件夹树缺少 My workspace 根节点，原生 Parent folder 下拉包含大量目录时会展开占满屏幕。
acceptance_criteria: 根节点可见且可选择；根节点仅允许新建子目录；Parent folder 使用可搜索且限定高度的滚动选择器；创建与移动流程保持可用并有测试。
notes: Root node now renders as selectable My workspace with only safe child-create management. Replaced native parent select with searchable custom listbox capped at 240px/38vh and internal scrolling. Browser verified 171 options, search filtering, and no live mutations.
close_reason: Closed

title: Render Agent clarification form as a top-level modal
description: The shared clarification dialog is visually constrained by the Ask AI session drawer. Mount it at the document root so the dynamic form is a distinct page-level modal while the session retains only prompts, reopen controls, and submitted answer records.
acceptance_criteria: Clarification dialog renders outside the Copilot/Plan/Recovery panel DOM; backdrop covers the viewport; session list does not contain form controls; Ask AI, Plan Assist, and Recovery still reopen and submit the form; tests and production build pass.
close_reason: Mounted the shared clarification dialog through a document-body portal, locked background scrolling while open, retained only reopen controls and answer records in Agent sessions, and passed focused tests plus production build.

title: Fix SurfaceMesh preview loading feedback and Tools overlay layering
description: SurfaceMesh 3D preview remains at 0% without meaningful progress updates, and the Tools popover is obscured by page content. Show percentage only when trustworthy byte progress exists; otherwise display clear loading stages, and ensure the Tools overlay renders above the resource page stacking contexts.
acceptance_criteria: No static or misleading 0% is shown; loading feedback distinguishes sync/manifest/resource preparation where observable and uses indeterminate state otherwise; Tools popover is above viewer and side panels; tests cover progress-label and overlay-layer behavior.
close_reason: Corrected the overlay diagnosis: moved the Tools menu into a body portal with fixed positioning, viewport clamping, and z-index 1000 so viewer overflow cannot clip it; full tests and production build pass.

title: Make AI responses follow the user's language
description: The shared CFD copilot prompt currently forces English replies. Remove that restriction so Ask AI, Plan assistance, and recovery responses follow the language of the user's latest request while keeping structured JSON field names stable.
acceptance_criteria: Shared AI prompt explicitly requires the response message, questions, warnings, assumptions, and explanatory text to use the latest user's language; structured protocol keys remain unchanged; prompt regression tests pass.
notes: Removed the English-only response requirement from the shared CFD copilot and dynamic chat prompt. Human-readable AgentAction values now follow the latest user request while protocol keys/enums/paths remain stable. Added the same language contract to Plan Assist initial/repair prompts, generic AgentAction repair, Recovery, and AI Create project/summary/assumptions. Added Chinese local fallback output and prompt/localization regression tests. Verified go test ./..., make build, and git diff check.
close_reason: All model-backed AI workflows now follow the user's language without changing structured protocol identifiers.

title: Build adaptive multi-CSV chart explorer
description: Case result CSVs are currently limited to table previews. Introduce a reusable tabular-data abstraction and chart panel that infers useful axes/series from column characteristics, supports compatible multi-file comparison, and retains the table as a secondary view.
design: Parse CSV into typed column profiles; infer numeric/categorical, monotonic/index-like axes, and line/bar presentation; compare datasets by row count and shared typed columns; render responsive SVG without adding a heavyweight chart dependency; expose file, axis, and series controls with clear incompatibility reasons.
acceptance_criteria: Opening a Case CSV defaults to an attractive inferred chart when chartable; users can switch Chart/Table, choose x-axis and numeric series, and add/remove compatible CSV artifacts; incompatible files explain row/column mismatch; parsing and inference remain reusable and tested; real Case review, full tests, typecheck, and production build pass.
close_reason: Built adaptive CSV chart explorer with typed profiling, inferred axes/chart/scale, compatible multi-file comparison, table fallback, real residual/CFL validation, 277 tests, typecheck, and production build.

title: Bind Ask AI context and persist project/resource conversations
description: Project-page Ask AI currently sends prose that the structured prompt parser drops, uses a fixed web:workspace session token, keeps messages only in React memory, and mixes Chinese UI copy into an English product surface. Send auditable structured project/resource CFD context, persist conversation history per project/resource across revisits and server restarts, and make the Ask AI experience English.
acceptance_criteria: Model prompt receives project and selected resource identity plus available CFD detail, SimulationParams, errors/results and inventory context in a bounded structured payload; Ask AI messages are stored and restored independently for each project/resource; switching resources does not leak history; user-facing Ask AI copy is English; automated Go/React tests and production build pass.
notes: Implemented structured Ask AI context with project identity, solver version, selected resource identity/status/info/state/summary, selected SimulationParams, result artifact inventory, partial errors, full project resource inventory, active Draft and SimulationParams, scope counts, and execution boundary. Changed the prompt to answer explanatory CFD questions directly in English and reserve AgentAction JSON for plans. Added disk-backed project/resource chat sessions, server-authoritative restored history, scope/context validation, English UI/fallback copy, and regression tests. Verified go test ./..., 268 Vitest tests, TypeScript/Vite production build, make build, and git diff check.
close_reason: Ask AI now receives structured CFD context, answers in English, and restores isolated persistent conversations for the same project/resource.

title: Make Plan intent optional outside AI parameter fill
description: The natural-language simulation goal is currently required by browser validation and planCompileBlockers, blocking Compile & validate even when users configure parameters manually. Treat it as optional AI guidance; require it only for AI form fill and derive a route-based audit intent for normal compilation.
acceptance_criteria: An empty description does not block Compile & validate; AI fill remains disabled and clearly explains that a description is needed; compiled plans receive a deterministic source-to-target audit intent; explicit user intent remains unchanged; tests/build pass.
notes: Removed intent from planCompileBlockers and the browser required constraint. The AI form-fill button remains disabled without a description and now explains that the field is optional and AI-only. Core plans accept omitted intent and derive a deterministic source-to-target audit statement while preserving explicit user intent. Verified plans tests/race/vet, all 260 React tests, TypeScript/Vite build, embedded make build, and server tests (with localhost httptest permission).
close_reason: Natural-language intent is now optional for manual Compile & validate and required only to invoke AI parameter fill.

title: Fix malformed SurfaceMesh boundary inventory rows
description: SurfaceMesh boundary rows inherit the later Geometry entity-select grid styles, squeezing name, assignment, and triangle metadata into one truncated line while the action column stretches each row. Add a scoped compact two-line layout for SurfaceMesh inventory rows.
acceptance_criteria: SurfaceMesh face rows show name and assignment on the first line, status and triangle count on the second, with compact visibility/isolate actions and no horizontal overflow; relevant tests and production build pass.
close_reason: Added a scoped compact two-line SurfaceMesh boundary row layout that overrides the incompatible Geometry entity grid; focused tests and production build pass.

title: Prevent viewer tools menu from being clipped by inspector
description: At constrained viewer widths or browser zoom, the single-row viewer tools menu extends beyond the center viewport and is clipped behind the right inspector, hiding Area and Box. Reflow the menu into a compact bounded grid so every tool remains visible.
acceptance_criteria: All nine viewer tools remain visible inside the viewer at constrained desktop widths and browser zoom; compact/mobile layout remains usable; UI tests and production build pass.
close_reason: Reflowed the viewer tools menu into a bounded five-column desktop and three-column compact grid so all tools remain inside the viewer; component tests and production build pass.

title: Integrate Flow360 Drafts into Project home
description: Make remote Flow360 Drafts first-class on the existing Project detail page. Add backend draft listing/detail support, a project-level draft selector/list with lifecycle metadata, and make the active workspace/parameter context follow the selected draft while preserving approval-before-run.
acceptance_criteria: Project detail loads remote Drafts for its project, visibly lists and switches them, represents loading/empty/error states, and selected Draft SimulationParams are available in the existing project workspace without initiating a run. Tests and web build pass.
close_reason: Added Project-scoped remote Draft list and Draft detail APIs, persistent Draft switcher on the Project canvas, parameter inspection drawer, active Draft AI context, responsive states, caching, and regression coverage.

title: Expand AI Create exact CAD beyond single solids
description: Remove the artificial exactly-one-solid restriction from AI Create while retaining CadQuery/OpenCascade as the sole CAD backend. Extend GeometrySpec with loft, sweep, multi-result composition, and stable body/face topology labels; update validation, prompts, and tests.
acceptance_criteria: AI Create can generate and round-trip valid multi-solid STEP geometry; GeometrySpec supports loft and sweep; generated validation exposes stable body/face labels; OpenSCAD is not introduced; automated tests pass.
close_reason: Removed the artificial single-solid constraint; added named multi-body STEP, exact spline profiles, loft, sweep, face selectors, XCAF topology metadata, validation, and passing integration tests.

title: Clarify AI parameter assist context and improve readability
description: The simulation intent assistant is being mistaken for homepage AI Create and its response text is too small. Make the existing-Geometry context explicit, prevent misleading claims about uploaded geometry, and increase assistant result typography for readable review.
close_reason: Clarified that Plan assistance operates on an existing resource, taught the Agent to select explicit reviewable defaults for basic baselines without inventing CAD evidence, and enlarged the assistant result typography.

title: Recover AI Create Project IDs from variable Flow360 CLI output
description: Flow360 creates a v4 STEP Project successfully but AI Create still reports no Project ID when CLI output is not the expected JSON shape. Preserve full compact CLI output, recover prj-* IDs from nested text, and reconcile the created Project/root without duplicating paid work.
close_reason: Project creation now preserves structured and compact raw CLI output, recovers prj-* IDs from nested text, and reconciles the root Geometry through Project Items. Added regression coverage for the live response shape.

title: Fix AI Create BREP project import failure
description: AI Create reports Flow360 did not accept the generated exact-CAD cylinder Project. Preserve the raw CLI failure, correct the import contract, surface actionable errors, and verify end-to-end without starting paid jobs.
close_reason: Replaced unsupported native BREP upload with CAD-kernel-generated STEP, fixed typed Project ID recovery, added actionable error classification, and verified the full live AI Create path through Flow360 schema preflight.

title: Remove redundant geometry unit confirmation checkbox
description: Geometry import already uses a controlled canonical length-unit selector. Remove the duplicate confirmation checkbox and its client-side blocking while preserving server-side unit validation and import review.
acceptance_criteria: Geometry import shows the controlled unit selector without a confirmation checkbox; staging and execution are not blocked by duplicate confirmation; canonical units and server validation remain; tests and build pass.
notes: Removed the duplicate Geometry unit confirmation checkbox and all client-side staging/execution gates tied to it. A selected canonical unit now serves as confirmation; server accepts only m, mm, cm, or inch, persists compatibility confirmation internally, and revalidates before approval/execution. Resumed drafts still require the single final billable-action review. Verified go test ./..., 243 Vitest tests, production build, embedded asset scan, and git diff check.
close_reason: Geometry import now uses one controlled unit selector with strict server validation and no redundant confirmation checkbox.

title: Make AI Create produce a preflight-complete simulation setup
description: AI Create must populate all required Surface Mesh, Volume Mesh, and Case SimulationParams from actual geometry context, run installed Flow360 schema preflight, and only report ready when validation passes. Preserve review/approval before paid jobs.
close_reason: AI Create now waits for a complete Geometry baseline, resolves actual CAD faces into Wall models, supplies required meshing defaults, and requires installed Flow360 schema preflight success.

title: Harden AI action repair against invalid UTF-8 and fields shape drift
description: AI form fill repair can pass byte-truncated Chinese text containing invalid UTF-8 to external Codex, and AgentAction parsing rejects object-shaped proposal fields. Make prompt truncation UTF-8 safe, tighten the output contract, accept narrowly defined legacy/object fields shapes, and add regression tests.
acceptance_criteria: All prompts sent to providers are valid UTF-8; proposal fields contract is explicit; supported object-shaped fields normalize to canonical arrays; malformed shapes remain rejected; regression tests pass.
notes: Made all prompt truncation UTF-8 safe, including recovery feedback; sanitized both system and user prompts again at the external Codex stdin boundary. Clarified the canonical AgentAction fields array in initial and repair prompts. Added narrow normalization for singleton field objects and path-keyed field descriptor objects; primitive maps remain rejected for repair. Required proposal id/intent/field keys and JSON-object patches. Added regression tests for multibyte boundaries, invalid bytes, provider stdin, accepted object drift, rejected primitive maps, and rejected non-object patches. Agent tests, race test, go vet, production build, isolated server flake test x3, and all other Go tests pass. Full suite exposes pre-existing async TempDir cleanup race tracked as flow360-cli-n0o.
close_reason: UTF-8 handling and AgentAction parsing/output contract are hardened with regression coverage.

title: Move AI Create into an English modal beside New project
description: Replace the always-visible Workspace AI Create card with a compact AI Create button next to New project. Clicking it opens an accessible modal. All user-facing copy in the AI Create flow must be English.
acceptance_criteria: AI Create button appears beside New project for a selected folder; no AI Create card occupies the project list page; clicking opens a focus-managed modal; Escape, close button, and backdrop close it when creation is idle; all modal placeholder/example/progress/error/safety text is English; successful creation still navigates to the new Project; tests and production build pass.
notes: Moved the always-visible AI Create card into an accessible modal opened by a new AI Create button beside New project. Modal copy, placeholder, example, progress, error surface, destination label, and approval notice are English-only. Added focus trap, automatic textarea focus, focus restoration, Escape/backdrop/close-button dismissal while idle, and close locking during creation. Mobile header actions stack and share width. Verified 241 Vitest tests, TypeScript/Vite production build, make build, and git diff check.
close_reason: AI Create now opens as an English accessible modal from a button beside New project; full web tests and production build pass.

title: 将首页 Ask AI 升级为 AI Create 项目生成入口
description: 用户希望在首页输入自然语言仿真需求，由 AI 自动创建并配置一个可直接进入仿真准备状态的 Flow360 Project。首个代表性场景为圆柱绕流。需要复用现有 agent/project/import/plan 能力，提供清晰的生成进度、结果跳转与失败恢复。
design: 保持 agent-first：自然语言是主入口，AI 可生成低风险本地草案与校验；远程付费运行仍需显式审批。优先串联现有能力，避免另建一套孤立工作流。
acceptance_criteria: 首页展示 AI Create 主入口；提交需求后调用后端创建流程并显示阶段进度；成功后生成 Project 并可直接进入已加载模型和仿真参数的项目页；至少覆盖圆柱绕流示例；包含前后端自动化测试并通过构建。
notes: 已完成首页 AI Create 垂直切片：首页自然语言主入口替代 Workspace Ask AI；选择目标 Folder 后可提交圆柱扰流需求；后端生成封闭 64 段圆柱 STL，调用 Flow360 project create，并为新 Geometry 自动保存 run-up-to Case 的 SimulationParams 草案、provenance、假设和审批边界；创建后直接进入 Project。非圆柱需求返回明确 CAD/模板提示。新增 Go 与 React 测试。验证：go test ./... 全部通过；Vitest 47 files / 241 tests 通过；TypeScript/Vite 与 make build 通过。一般化几何模板与 CAD 编排由 flow360-cli-aov 跟踪。
close_reason: 首页 AI Create 已能从圆柱绕流自然语言需求生成几何、创建 Flow360 Project、附带可审查 Case 参数计划并跳转项目页；全量测试和生产构建通过。

title: Merge Plan engineering intent and AI prompt
description: The Plan form currently asks users for both Engineering intent and an AI form-fill prompt even though both describe the same simulation goal. Replace them with one natural-language input used for plan audit context and optional AI parameter filling.
acceptance_criteria: Plan creation shows one natural-language goal input; the same value is used for plan intent and AI form filling; compile and AI button prerequisites remain explicit; tests, build, and browser verification pass.
notes: Removed the separate Engineering intent field and AI prompt state. The single What do you want to simulate? value is now sent as both auditable plan intent and Agent form-fill instruction; it independently enables local compile and optional AI fill. Real browser verified one input, zero Engineering intent labels, both actions enabling from the same text, and zero overflow. 239 Vitest tests and production build pass.
close_reason: Plan goal and AI instruction are now one natural-language input with shared compile and AI behavior.

title: Align SurfaceMesh inventory controls with Geometry
description: SurfaceMesh 'Show all faces' and selected-row presentation differ from Geometry inventory. Reuse the Geometry interaction classes/pattern for the footer restore action and selected state while preserving SurfaceMesh boundary-specific data and actions.
acceptance_criteria: Surface selected rows use the same visual hierarchy as Geometry selected entities; Show all faces uses the same full-width inventory restore control style and disabled/active semantics; labels remain accessible; component tests cover selection and show-all state.
close_reason: Aligned SurfaceMesh inventory rows, selected state, selection count, and Show all faces control with Geometry; added regression coverage and verified full tests/build.

title: Keep project annotations when local API fetch fails
description: Project Annotation panel currently shows 0/0 and clears its in-memory list whenever the local VibeSim annotation API returns Failed to fetch or Retry starts. A transient local-server outage must not make saved project annotations disappear. Confirm the Go CRUD API is packaged in the deployed local binary and preserves data across restart.
design: ProjectAnnotationsController must retain the last successful project-scoped cache on same-project load/retry failures, keep stale annotations visible with an explicit error/stale state, and clear data only when projectId actually changes. Retry should set loading without clearing annotations or active draft. On first load with cached data, publish cached annotations immediately. Never fall back to browser localStorage: the source of truth remains the local Go annotations.Store under VIBESIM_DATA_DIR, scoped by environment/profile/projectId. Add tests for failure, retry, project switch and recovery; rebuild and restart 9292, then verify CRUD and restart persistence.
acceptance_criteria: After a successful load, a simulated Failed to fetch leaves annotation count and rows intact while showing retryable error; retry success replaces stale data and clears error; switching Project never leaks old records; fresh Project with no cache remains empty on failure; current local server exposes GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE annotation routes; an annotation survives server restart; Vitest, Go tests, build and browser validation pass.
notes: Implemented project-scoped stale-data retention in ProjectAnnotationsController: retry and fetch errors no longer clear annotations or active draft; cached target-project rows remain visible during refresh; success replaces stale data. AnnotationPanel distinguishes first load from background refresh and explains when last local-server data is shown. Verified 238/238 Vitest tests, TypeScript/Vite production build, Go annotations/store and HTTP handler tests, embedded binary on 9292, 5/5 records after restart, and real Geometry panel rendering. Local Go store remains source of truth; no browser localStorage added.
close_reason: Transient local API failures now preserve visible project annotations; local server persistence and recovery are verified.

title: Explain and unblock Plan compilation after AI fill
description: AI form fill may return missing-input questions while Compile & validate remains disabled with no visible reason. Make the compile prerequisites explicit, carry a useful AI intent into the plan, and ensure users can continue answering missing inputs without guessing why the primary action is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Compile button shows its exact blocking prerequisites; AI-generated proposal/intent updates the plan fields; missing-input responses clearly direct the user to answer and retry; tests and production build pass.
notes: Root cause: Compile & validate silently required Engineering intent, but AI prompt text was not propagated there; 6KB SimulationParams prompt cap also caused typical Case snapshots to be truncated. Fixed by deriving intent from the AI prompt, applying proposal intent, showing exact compile blockers/readiness, adding missing-input retry guidance, and retaining up to 48KB of SimulationParams context. Verified real browser transition disabled->enabled, no overflow, Go test/race/vet, 234 Vitest tests, and production build.
close_reason: Plan compilation prerequisites are now explicit and AI fill unblocks local compile validation while retaining complete typical Case context.

title: Fix Volume Mesh review layout collisions and duplicate panels
description: Resolve screenshot-reported Volume Mesh UI defects: stage connector overlaps labels, viewer source and toolbar overlays obscure the model, the built-in entity legend duplicates the left inventory, and readiness checks are clipped in the inspector.
acceptance_criteria: Stage labels remain unobscured; volume source context and controls do not cover the model; only the left region inventory is shown; all readiness checks fit the inspector width; focused tests and production build pass.
close_reason: Fixed stage connector label overlap, removed the redundant VolumeMesh viewer legend and source overlay, reserved a non-overlapping control rail for review viewers, and constrained readiness checks to one inspector column. All web tests, TypeScript, and production build pass.

title: 支持 Viewer 工具点位拖动与无吸附回退
description: 工具完成后的控制点应可拖动微调；当鼠标下方没有可捕捉几何特征时，仍应使用鼠标对应的三维点继续工具交互。
design: 扩展 picking hit 产生与 overlay 控制点交互；优先捕捉 vertex/edge/surface，未命中时使用相机射线与稳定交互平面求交；拖动更新草稿结果，保存后可进入编辑态并持久化更新。共享 Viewer3D 接口由协调者串行集成。
acceptance_criteria: 无 snap 候选时点击仍产生 fallback point；完成态控制点可拖动并实时更新结果；保存后 annotation 可重新编辑；不破坏 Esc/Enter/Backspace 与输入框保护；单元测试和真实 Viewer 验收通过。
close_reason: 无几何命中时以相机对齐交互平面生成 snap:none 自由点；完成态/保存态控制点支持拖动实时重算并通过 PATCH 持久化；真实 Viewer 自由点 Line 从 0.1644115 拖动到 0.1452217，相关测试、全量 build/Go tests 通过。提交 6d81d9c。

title: 优化 Annotations 可见性、筛选与列表密度
description: Annotations 列表需要明确的显示/隐藏状态、较紧凑字号，并支持按工具类型和所属资源筛选。
design: 在 Project Annotation panel 增加 All/Visible/Hidden 状态筛选、Tool 与 Resource 下拉筛选；每行提供可访问的 visibility toggle，压缩 typography/spacing，保留 focus/delete 能力。
acceptance_criteria: 每条 annotation 可显示/隐藏并有明确状态；按可见性、工具类型、资源组合筛选；列表字体和行高显著收紧；空筛选结果有清晰提示；组件测试通过。
close_reason: Annotations 增加 Visible/Hidden 状态与 toggle、All/Visible/Hidden + Tool + Resource 组合筛选、紧凑列表和无匹配提示；组件 5 tests 与真实项目列表筛选验收通过。提交 2ff2423。

title: 扩展 Viewer 几何工具集合
description: 在现有 Distance、Point、Line、Sphere、Polyline、Angle 基础上增加实用的 3D 标注与测量工具，并复用统一 ToolDefinition/Annotation/Overlay 架构。
design: 优先增加 Circle、Area、Box 三类可由点序列确定且能稳定保存/重放的工具；工具注册、几何结果、summary 与 overlay 保持数据驱动。
acceptance_criteria: Tools 工具条展示新增工具；每个工具可拾取完成、显示结果、保存并重放；相关 geometry/definition tests 通过。
close_reason: 新增 Circle、Area、Box，完成几何计算、结果校验、overlay、inspector、工具条图标和保存重放；相关 19 tests 通过，全量 build 与真实 Viewer 九工具验收通过。提交 063c98a。

title: 重构 Viewer Tools 工具条与右上角交互面板
description: 当前 Drawing and measurement tools 卡片将工具选择、状态、结果和保存操作堆在同一区域，视觉拥挤且破坏 Viewer 主次关系。将底部 Measure 入口改为统一 Tools 入口，按需展开所有注册工具；选中工具后在右上角独立 panel 完成提示、结果和保存交互。
design: Viewer 底部只显示 Tools launcher；launcher 展开紧凑注册工具条，覆盖 Distance、Point、Line、Sphere、Polyline、Angle。激活工具时保持单一模式，右上角浮层显示共享工具标题、拾取提示、结果、Save/Retry/Discard/Close；Workspace 不再直接渲染大型工具卡片。复用 ToolDefinition、useViewerTools/useDistanceTool 和现有 Project Annotation store，不向 Viewer3D 增加 tool-specific props。
acceptance_criteria: 底部 Measure 替换为 Tools；Tools 可展开/收起包含全部注册工具；选择工具进入独占模式并有明确激活态；右上角 panel 承担提示、结果和 Save/Retry/Discard；Distance 与五个基础工具均可用；键盘 Esc/Enter/Backspace 与输入框保护不回归；Geometry、SurfaceMesh、VolumeMesh、Case 的统一入口布局可用；相关 Vitest、build 和真实 Viewer 浏览器验收通过。
close_reason: 已将四类 Viewer 工作区底部 Measure 统一替换为 Tools launcher，展开 Distance/Point/Line/Sphere/Polyline/Angle 六工具并实现独占模式；右上角共享 panel 承担引导、结果与 Save/Retry/Discard/Close。验证：Vitest 46 files/226 tests、go test ./...、npm run build、make build、git diff --check、真实 Geometry Viewer 点拾取与模式切换均通过。代码提交 6536a1a。

title: 允许受限规模的多切片 VolumeMesh UVF 预览
description: 真实 VolumeMesh vm-911c1d77 的 37 个 SolidGeometry 各自引用低 LOD buffer，总 manifest 约 103 KB，却被 UVFLoader 的 maxBufferFiles=10 拒绝，导致 Distance 无法做真实浏览器验收。
design: 在保留单文件、manifest 和总体下载安全边界的前提下允许合法的多切片低 LOD 清单；增加文件数边界及总字节预算测试，禁止无界放宽。
acceptance_criteria: 37-buffer 真实形态可加载；超过文件数或总体字节预算仍被拒绝；UVF 单测、production build 和真实 VolumeMesh Viewer Distance 浏览器流程通过。
close_reason: Raised the bounded UVF file-count allowance to 64 while adding a 256 MiB aggregate budget, covered 37/65-file and byte-limit boundaries, moved the CFD toolbar out from under the decision panel, passed UVF tests and release build, and completed real vm-911c1d77 VolumeMesh Distance pick/save/overlay browser validation.

title: 以 Distance Tool 迁移 Geometry 和 SurfaceMesh Measure
description: 用新工具框架重新实现现有 Measure，作为端到端架构验证。先覆盖 Geometry 和 SurfaceMesh，移除两处重复的 measurementEnabled/measurementPoints 业务状态和 Viewer3D 的专用 Measure props。
design: 注册 distance ToolDefinition：exactly 2 points、surface pick policy、第二点自动完成。activate 后显示可访问引导；第一点后显示 marker、rubber-band preview 和 Select second point；第二点后停止 capture 并进入 complete-draft。结果计算 distance、deltaX/Y/Z、起终点、单位和 snap/entity 元数据。详情面板提供 Save、Retry、Discard；Save 写入当前 Project Store，成功后进入统一列表。Esc 取消，Retry 清空点但保持工具激活。不要在完成后第三次点击自动覆盖旧结果。保留旧 measurementDistance 测试作为计算回归，再删除重复 hook 状态。
acceptance_criteria: Geometry 和 SurfaceMesh 使用相同 Distance definition、runtime、overlay 和 Project list；第二点自动结束且不再改变实体 selection；详情显示长度和坐标分量；Save 后刷新仍存在且只在当前 Project 可见；Retry、Discard、Esc 和保存失败可恢复；旧 measurementPoints/onPickPoint API 被移除或标记为临时兼容且有清理任务；浏览器在两个真实 Resource 上验收。
notes: 迁移落点：GeometryWorkspace.tsx 的 measurementEnabled、measurementPoints、geometryMeasurementDistance、Measure toolbar 和 Inspection card；useSurfaceMeshAdvancedReview.ts 的 reducer actions 和 SurfaceAdvancedReview.tsx；Viewer3D.tsx 的 measurementPoints/onPickPoint props、measurementOverlayRef、overlay effect 和 handleClick 分支；LazyViewer3D.tsx 的专用 props。先兼容后删除时必须在同一 bead 内完成或明确记录 cleanup。
close_reason: Unified two-point Distance Tool now drives Geometry and SurfaceMesh through the shared runtime, picking, overlays, and Project annotation store; legacy measurement props/state are removed. Verified with 189 Vitest tests, production build, full Go tests, diff check, and real cached Geometry/SurfaceMesh browser flows covering auto-complete, result fields, Retry/Discard/Esc, save failure recovery, refresh persistence, and Project isolation.

title: 实现 Project Annotation 客户端状态与统一列表
description: 建立当前 Project 唯一的 Annotation 客户端数据源和统一管理列表。不同 Resource Workspace 复用同一个 hook 和 UI，但绝不加载其他 Project 的 Annotation。
design: 新增 api annotation methods、useProjectAnnotations(projectId) 和 AnnotationPanel。查询 key 必须包含 projectId；projectId 变化时 abort 旧请求、清空旧数据和 active draft，再加载新 Project。保存采用明确 saving/error 状态，可做 optimistic update 但失败必须回滚。列表显示 tool type、名称、来源 resource、摘要、可见状态和更新时间，支持 show/hide、focus、rename、delete、retry。列表是 Project 全量；当前 Viewer 只渲染由 ViewerContextCompatibility 判定为 compatible 的 Annotation，其余显示来源但不强行投影。Annotation 可见性是否持久化需统一：建议持久化用户设置。
acceptance_criteria: 切换 Project 时旧 Annotation 在新请求完成前也不会闪现；Project 列表 CRUD 和错误重试可用；当前 Resource 只渲染兼容坐标系的 Annotation；隐藏、聚焦、重命名、删除具备可访问名称和确认策略；API mock 测试覆盖竞态、abort、rollback、空态和跨 Project cache 污染。
close_reason: Added project-scoped annotation controller/hook, abort-safe loading, optimistic CRUD rollback, compatibility filtering, and accessible Project Annotation drawer; 186 Vitest tests, build, and real Project browser panel validation pass.

title: 建立通用 Annotation Overlay 渲染层
description: 用通用 OverlayPrimitive 渲染工具草稿和已保存 Annotation，移除 Viewer3D 内写死的 measurement overlay。第一阶段支持 point、polyline、label 和 sphere，且草稿预览和保存结果共用渲染路径。
design: 新增 ViewerOverlayLayer 或 useViewerOverlays 适配器，把领域层 OverlayPrimitive 转为 THREE.Group、Mesh、Line、Sprite 或 DOM label。Overlay 使用专用 Object3D group、renderOrder 和 layer；默认不参与 picking。统一处理 asset local 到 world transform、深度策略、颜色、透明度、线宽降级和单位标签。更新时按 annotation/primitive key 增量复用对象，删除和资源切换时 dispose geometry、material、texture。点尺寸和文字应采用屏幕可读策略，避免依赖模型绝对尺度；截图路径必须包含 Overlay。
acceptance_criteria: Point、两点线、N 点 polyline、球和文本标签可由数据驱动渲染；hover draft 和 saved annotation 可同时存在；显隐切换不重建 UVF asset；Overlay 不被 Picking Engine 命中；资源切换无残影；dispose、坐标变换、空 primitive、更新复用有测试；高 DPI 和截图浏览器验收通过。
close_reason: Data-driven point/polyline/sphere/label overlay layer is integrated into Viewer3D with keyed reuse, transforms, disposal, non-pickable layer, high-DPI labels, and capture inclusion; 8 focused tests, full web tests/build, and browser screenshot harness pass.

title: 抽取统一 Picking Engine 与 Viewer 输入仲裁
description: 把 Viewer3D 当前点击中的 raycast、实体选择、field probe 和 point pick 拆成统一 Picking Engine，使激活工具能够优先消费点击，同时保留相机拖动、实体选择和 hover。第一阶段交付可靠 Surface Pick 和丰富 PickResult。
design: 新增 buildPointerRay、pickScene、resolvePickCandidate 和 ViewerInputController。使用 THREE.Raycaster.setFromCamera；仅查询可见且属于 pickable layer 的 UVF Mesh，Overlay 放在独立 layer 并排除。Intersection 转为 PickResult：命中对象稳定 entityId、faceIndex、local/world position、插值或 face normal、resourceRef 和 coordinateFrame。用 pointerdown/up 的像素位移阈值区分 click 与 OrbitControls drag。输入优先级为 active tool、field probe、entity selection；工具消费事件时不得重新选择或重新聚焦实体。hover 只产生临时候选，不提交点。接口允许后续 Line、Points 和 snap resolver 扩展。
acceptance_criteria: 激活工具时单击只提交一次 PickResult，不触发实体 selection；相机拖动不提交点；隐藏实体、wireframe 和 annotation overlay 不可拾取；无命中时行为可配置；世界与 asset local 坐标转换正确；Geometry、indexed/non-indexed UVF Mesh 有单元测试；现有 selection 和 field probe 无回归。
notes: 实现调研：THREE.Raycaster.intersectObjects 返回按距离排序的 Intersection，并可通过 Raycaster/Object3D Layers 过滤对象；Line 和 Points 有独立 threshold，但其单位是 world units，因此最终 snap 体验必须换算为屏幕像素。参考：https://threejs.org/docs/pages/Raycaster.html ，https://threejs.org/docs/pages/Layers.html ，https://threejs.org/docs/pages/Object3D.html
close_reason: Unified surface Picking Engine and input arbitration are integrated into Viewer3D with drag suppression, tool/probe/selection priority, additive modifiers, coordinate/normal handling, and overlay exclusion; 12 focused tests, full web tests/build, and browser harness pass.

title: 实现 Project 隔离的 Annotation Store 与 CRUD API
description: 为 Viewer Annotation 提供 VibeSim 本地服务端持久化。Annotation 只属于一个 Project；列表、读取、创建、修改和删除都必须从 URL projectId 获取作用域，客户端 payload 不得覆盖归属。
design: 新增 internal/annotations 包和 Server 依赖，遵循现有 plans.Store 的 mutex、JSON、0600 文件权限和可重启设计。建议目录为 VIBESIM_DATA_DIR/annotations/<environment-profile-namespace>/<validated-project-id>/，每条 Annotation 独立 JSON 或使用带原子替换的 project JSON；优先独立文件减少整表写冲突。API 建议 GET/POST /api/projects/:project_id/annotations，GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/projects/:project_id/annotations/:annotation_id。创建时由服务端生成 annotation ID、projectId、createdAt、updatedAt；校验 projectId、annotationId 和 resourceRef，阻止路径穿越、跨 Project IDOR、未知 schemaVersion、超大 payload 和非有限数值。PATCH 使用白名单字段并保留归属与创建时间。定义 NotFound、Conflict、Validation 错误映射。
acceptance_criteria: Project A 无法通过任何 ID 读取或修改 Project B 的 Annotation；重启后数据存在；CRUD、空列表、坏 JSON、并发写、路径穿越、非有限坐标、错误 schemaVersion 和跨 Project 测试通过；API client 类型和错误处理齐全；磁盘权限和原子写符合现有 Store 约定。
notes: 本地实现参考：internal/plans/store.go 已提供 mutex、JSON 文件、重启恢复模式；internal/projectcache/store.go 与 internal/projectmirror/store.go 提供目录验证和命名空间参考；internal/server/server.go 从 VIBESIM_DATA_DIR 初始化 Store。Annotation Store 应独立成包，不写入 Flow360 remote metadata。
close_reason: Project-scoped Annotation store and CRUD API enforce IDOR isolation, strict validation, atomic 0600 persistence, restart/concurrency safety, and typed client errors; race tests, full Go tests, Vitest, and build pass.

title: 定义 3D Tool、Pick 和 Annotation 领域契约
description: 建立共享且不依赖具体 Workspace 的领域模型，替代 Viewer3D 的 measurementPoints 和 onPickPoint 专用接口。模型必须覆盖固定点数工具、不定点数工具、草稿会话、已保存 Annotation、资源锚点和坐标系。
design: 在 web/src/lib/viewer-tools 下定义只读 TypeScript 接口和判别联合：PickResult 包含 local/world position、projectId、resourceRef、entityId/type、triangleIndex、vertexIndex、normal、snap type/distance/confidence；ToolDefinition 组合 completion policy、PickPolicy、ResultComputer、OverlayFactory 和 InspectorDefinition；ToolSession 状态为 idle、armed、collecting、complete-draft、saving、saved、cancelled、error；ViewerAnnotation 含 schemaVersion、projectId、resourceRef、coordinateFrame、toolId、points、result、style、visible 和时间戳。使用纯 reducer 和纯计算函数。不要让持久化类型持有 THREE.Object3D、Vector3 或函数。接口优先，复用行为通过 createFixedPointTool 等工厂组合；除非证明有不可变生命周期模板，否则不引入 abstract base class。
acceptance_criteria: 类型可由普通对象实现；Distance 和 Polyline 的测试定义能共享运行时；reducer 覆盖 activate、pick、hover、undo-last、finish、cancel、retry、save success/failure；固定点数自动完成，开放点数仅在达到 minPoints 后允许 Enter 完成；序列化模型不含 Three.js 实例；单元测试覆盖非法状态转换和 schema version。
notes: 实现调研：TypeScript 使用结构化类型，普通对象只要满足 shape 即可实现契约；implements 只检查实例侧契约，不提供实现复用。因此优先接口、判别联合、纯函数和工厂组合，不使用深继承。React 官方建议 reducer 集中复杂状态转换。参考：https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/interfaces.html ，https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/2/classes.html ，https://react.dev/learn/extracting-state-logic-into-a-reducer
close_reason: Defined plain TypeScript tool, pick, session, overlay, and annotation contracts with shared fixed/open-point runtime; 9 focused Vitest cases and npm run build pass.

title: 建立 Project 级 3D 工具与 Annotation 框架
description: 将现有写死的两点 Measure 重构为 Geometry、SurfaceMesh、VolumeMesh、Case 共用的 3D 交互工具平台。Annotation 只在当前 Project 内共享和持久化，禁止跨 Project 读取、写入或聚合。
design: 采用 TypeScript 接口加组合，而不是深层类继承。核心契约包括 PickResult、ToolDefinition、ToolSession、OverlayPrimitive、ViewerAnnotation、PickPolicy、ResultComputer 和 OverlayFactory。React 侧使用 reducer 状态机；Three.js 侧保持命令式渲染适配器。允许提供很薄的固定点数工具工厂，但所有工具都必须能以普通对象实现接口。Project 是持久化隔离边界，Resource 和 coordinate frame 是标注锚点。
acceptance_criteria: 完成所有子任务后，Distance、Polyline 等工具可通过注册方式接入；Geometry、Mesh 和 Case 使用相同运行时；Project Annotation CRUD 严格隔离；拾取、键盘结束、Overlay、保存列表和高级吸附有自动化测试与浏览器验收。
notes: 调研基线（2026-08-03）：GeometryWorkspace.tsx 和 useSurfaceMeshAdvancedReview.ts 各自维护 Measure 状态；Viewer3D.tsx 同时写死 measurement overlay、raycast、selection、probe 和 onPickPoint；VolumeMeshWorkspace.tsx 与 CaseWorkspace.tsx 已复用 LazyViewer3D，但没有共享 Tool Runtime。架构目标不是 Measurement 专用层，而是 Picking Engine + Tool Runtime + Overlay Renderer + Project Annotation Store。
close_reason: All eleven planned and discovered child beads are closed; project-scoped annotations, shared tool runtime, Distance across four workspaces, registered drawing tools, topology-aware snapping, and final release QA are implemented and verified.

title: Make SurfaceMesh fill opaque and wire an overlay
description: Field=None still shows mottled/camouflage artifacts because default visible mesh materials are transparent, and wireframe currently replaces filled triangles. Make normal visible surfaces opaque unless an explicit appearance requests transparency, and implement UVF wire as independent line overlay so fill, field coloring, and wire coexist.
acceptance_criteria: Default visible UVF/SurfaceMesh materials render opaque with no back-surface transparency pattern; explicit appearance opacity still works; enabling wire preserves filled material and vertex field colors; disabling wire removes/disposes overlays; repeated toggles do not duplicate lines; tests cover overlay coexistence and cleanup.
close_reason: Default faces now render opaque unless explicit alpha/appearance opacity is provided, and wire is a disposable LineSegments overlay that preserves fill and field coloring.

title: Support arbitrary UVF precision level switching
description: Expose generic Viewer3D precision/LOD selection for UVF manifests with any number of levels. Support Auto/default plus explicit levels, reload only the selected buffers, preserve resource display state, and avoid SurfaceMesh-specific logic.
design: Precision selection is a generic Viewer/UVF capability. Undefined LOD means manifest default; explicit numeric LOD reloads only that level's buffers. The global selector exposes the minimum level count shared by all multi-level solids, while single-buffer solids remain unchanged. LOD 0 is presented as highest detail and the final common level as lowest. Same-asset switches preserve camera and reapply field, visibility, selection, clip, normals, appearances, and wire state.
acceptance_criteria: Viewer discovers UVF LOD count/default; selector is hidden for single-level assets; multi-level assets offer Auto and every available level; selecting a level reloads that level and reports loading/error state; existing field and visibility behavior remains valid; parser/loader and UI state tests pass.
close_reason: Added generic arbitrary-level UVF precision selection with manifest default, common safe levels, level-specific reload, camera preservation, state reapplication, documentation, and tests.

title: Do not auto-display SurfaceMesh fields
description: When a SurfaceMesh UVF manifest contains fields, load it using normal entity materials like Geometry. Do not auto-select or color by the first field; quality coloring must require an explicit field choice and should reset on resource changes.
acceptance_criteria: SurfaceMesh initially renders without vertex field colors even when fields exist; entering quality mode alone does not select a field; choosing a field enables coloring; choosing None restores normal materials; tests cover discovery without auto-selection.
close_reason: Field discovery no longer auto-selects a quality field; manifest changes clear field display state and explicit selection is covered by tests.

title: Keep 3D camera clipping stable across zoom
description: Fix Viewer3D zoom disappearance by deriving safe OrbitControls distance bounds from fitted asset bounds and maintaining near/far clipping as camera distance changes. Apply consistently to fit, fit-selection, standard views, focus and resize; add camera math regression tests.
acceptance_criteria: Zooming throughout the supported distance range never clips the entire asset; near remains positive and far contains the asset; controls limits scale with asset radius; camera unit tests cover near and far zoom extremes.
close_reason: Viewer now maintains scale-aware OrbitControls distance limits and dynamically updates near/far clipping through close and far zoom; regression tests cover both extremes.

title: Diagnose 3D viewer disappearing during zoom
description: SurfaceMesh/geometry viewer can suddenly render nothing while zooming in or out. Determine whether camera clipping planes, controls limits, scene bounds, clipping state, or asset rebuilds cause the disappearance; report evidence before implementing a fix.
notes: Root cause found in Viewer3D camera lifecycle. fitPerspectiveCameraToObject sets near=max(0.001,distance-2*radius) and far=distance+4*radius once. OrbitControls defaults minDistance=0 and maxDistance=Infinity, and Viewer3D has no controls change listener to update near/far while dollying. After normalized asset fit, excessive zoom-in places the mesh at/behind the fixed near plane; excessive zoom-out puts it beyond the fixed far plane. The scene/asset is not unloaded. Explicit clipPlane is independent and only contributes if enabled.
close_reason: Diagnosed fixed camera near/far planes combined with unbounded OrbitControls dolly as the disappearance cause.

title: Refine SurfaceMesh review panel information hierarchy
description: Remove SurfaceMesh review metrics and checks that only report missing or mechanically duplicated state, improve parameters and advanced review typography, and document interaction boundaries across Geometry, SurfaceMesh, VolumeMesh, and Case manifests.
design: Use layered resource capabilities: shared identity/lifecycle/preview hierarchy/visibility/selection/camera/clip/measure/capture; Geometry adds CAD topology, materials and semantic boundary intent; SurfaceMesh adds boundary assignments, surface discretization parameters and face-quality fields; VolumeMesh adds regions/zones, volume-cell quality and domain/layer evidence; Case adds solver state, convergence, monitors and physical result fields. Keep glanceable current-context facts and reversible controls inline; use dialogs for multi-step, cross-resource, destructive, expensive, approval-gated, or large diff workflows. Suppress absent metrics and positive status echoes; surface only actionable exceptions.
close_reason: Removed empty SurfaceMesh summary metrics and redundant success checks, retained actionable exception notices, and improved parameters/advanced review readability.

title: Improve SurfaceMesh quality field scaling and precision
description: SurfaceMesh field visualization should support simultaneous wire overlay and field coloring, Auto/Linear/Log10 scale modes, and adaptive numeric formatting so small values remain distinguishable. Keep scaling generic in the manifest/UVF renderer.
close_reason: Implemented simultaneous wire/field display, Auto/Linear/Log10 scaling, adaptive field range formatting, and regression tests.

title: Align SurfaceMesh with Geometry review layout
description: Optimize only the SurfaceMesh resource page by replacing its full-screen viewer with floating decision card with the same three-column review hierarchy used by Geometry: entity inventory, central 3D viewer, and scrollable engineering inspector.
design: Introduce a reusable React slot layout for resource review pages. SurfaceMesh supplies its boundary inventory, existing LazyViewer3D, and review/quality/parameter content through slots. Reuse the current Geometry grid contract and responsive behavior without changing Geometry, VolumeMesh, or Case business logic.
acceptance_criteria: SurfaceMesh presents a persistent left Boundary inventory, central viewer, and right engineering review panel with no overlapping floating decision card; selection and visibility remain synchronized; quality, parameters, advanced review and Plan Volume Mesh remain reachable; narrow layouts follow the Geometry responsive hierarchy; component tests, all Web tests, build, and diff check pass.
notes: Added reusable ResourceReviewLayout inventory/viewer/inspector slots and migrated SurfaceMesh from a full-screen viewer with overlapping floating decision panel to the same three-column hierarchy as Geometry. Boundaries remain synchronized in the left inventory, LazyViewer3D stays central, and readiness, metrics, checks, selection/quality, parameters, advanced review, and Plan Volume Mesh are in the scrollable right inspector. Added matching 1100/820/680 responsive collapse behavior. Verified 27 Vitest files / 126 tests, production build, and diff check.
close_reason: SurfaceMesh now follows the shared Geometry review layout and all automated gates pass.

title: Add Geometry face and edge visibility controls
description: Expose visible/hidden state for every Geometry Face and Edge, provide per-entity toggles in the inventory, and synchronize visibility to existing UVF entity objects without reloading the asset.
design: GeometryWorkspace owns a Surface/Edge visibility map and passes it to Viewer3D. Viewer3D resolves visibility for both manifest groups and edges, then calls UVF setEntityVisibility on the existing entity groups.
acceptance_criteria: Every Face and Edge row shows visible/hidden state and an accessible toggle; toggling immediately updates the 3D scene; counts show visible totals; hidden faces are not pickable; visibility resets safely per Geometry resource; tests, build, and target-resource browser validation pass.
close_reason: Surface and Edge rows now expose accessible visible/hidden toggles, synchronize both entity types to the UVF scene, report visible counts, reset per resource, and passed build/browser validation.

title: Clarify and fix Surface material assignment
description: Separate Surface material assignment from Material Library editing. Changing the selected surfaces' material must immediately rebind them by stable material ID; renaming a material must preserve associations; remove the built-in material concept so seeded materials behave like regular records.
design: Persist SurfaceID-to-MaterialID mappings. Treat names as editable labels only. Seed the library on first use, migrate older built-in-shaped storage, and when deleting a material reassign its surfaces to a remaining material.
acceptance_criteria: Selection properties provides a Surface material dropdown that immediately updates selected faces; assignments store material IDs and survive material renames; Material Library dropdown only chooses the record being edited; seeded materials have no built-in label or edit restriction and can be deleted with safe reassignment; tests and target-resource browser validation pass.
close_reason: Separated immediate Surface material assignment from Material Library record editing; removed built-in semantics; persisted versioned regular material records; kept Surface links by stable material ID across renames; safely reassigned surfaces on deletion; validated update, rename, reload, and deletion flows on target UVF Geometry.

title: Allow editing built-in display material opacity
description: Built-in display materials currently disable name, color, and opacity controls, making the default opacity appear broken. Allow built-in properties to be edited and persisted while protecting their IDs from deletion so all bound surfaces continue to update reactively.
acceptance_criteria: Opacity, color, and name controls work for built-in and custom display materials; edits retain the material ID and propagate to every bound face; built-ins cannot be deleted; overrides survive reload; tests and target-resource browser validation pass.
close_reason: Enabled direct edits for built-in display material name, color, and opacity while protecting deletion; persisted builtin overrides; reactively bound unassigned faces to Default CAD; verified 90% to 25% live opacity across six faces and reload persistence on the target Geometry.

title: Make UVF surface appearances reactively bound
description: Make the Surface-to-Appearance relationship explicit and reactive. Faces retain appearance IDs, all UVF meshes bound to a changed appearance update immediately, and the UI shows which appearance each face uses. Built-in presets must not present editable controls that do not take effect.
design: Use React state as the source of truth: face assignments store appearance IDs, derived entity appearance props flow into Viewer3D, and a material synchronization effect updates existing UVF materials in place rather than reloading assets.
acceptance_criteria: Face inventory and selection properties display assigned appearance; editing a custom appearance immediately updates every bound UVF face without reload or re-apply; one appearance can update multiple faces; built-ins are visibly read-only with a duplicate-to-edit path; persistence, automated tests, and target-resource browser checks pass.
close_reason: Made Surface-to-display-material bindings explicit, auto-saved custom material edits directly into React state, synchronized color and opacity to all bound UVF faces on each input event, exposed material names in inventory and selection properties, and validated six-face live updates plus reset behavior on the target Geometry.

title: Fix live Geometry appearance updates
description: Geometry appearance assignments reach Viewer3D, but selected-face highlighting forces opacity to 1 and masks transparent appearance changes; removing an assignment can also leave a stale material color. Preserve assigned appearance while highlighting and restore defaults when assignments disappear.
acceptance_criteria: Applying color or opacity to currently selected faces updates the 3D canvas immediately; transparent presets remain visibly transparent while selected; removing an assignment restores the manifest default; automated and target-resource browser checks pass.
close_reason: Preserved assigned color and opacity under selection highlighting, restored manifest defaults when assignments disappear, added regression tests, and visually verified immediate 28% transparency on the target Geometry before deploying to 9292.

title: Add Geometry batch selection and shared appearances
description: Improve Geometry review interactions by keeping camera stable during entity selection, supporting multi-face selection and bulk semantic assignment, and adding a cross-project Appearance library without introducing physical materials.
